siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cuchara
siblings.summary: Bosland-anchored cycling, the Achel abbey, plus an honest map of what's actually inside the 30 km circle around Jan Tournier's two-Michelin-star restaurant — and what isn't.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cuchara
siblings.summary: Hotel Corbie at ~150 m and Mi Casa Naranja at ~4 min walk are the only true walk-back-from-dinner options; Cuchara's other two recommendations are taxi territory.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cuchara
siblings.summary: Five characterful stays inside a one-taxi hop of Cuchara: a 1904 engineer's villa, a Sahara-edge B&B, a forest-fringe boutique hotel, a Bosland glamping tent and a 1957 farm in Pelt.
